comparator.name: Islamabad/Gandhara Intl, IS, PK
comparator.elevation_note: Station elevation is absolute, not a difference from the device. Compute the actual gap before attributing anything to altitude.
comparator.caveat: Distance is 28.8 km, so surroundings differ. Altitude does not: the two sites are within tens of metres. Report the real elevation gap, not the station's absolute height.

caveats: The station reports whole degrees Celsius, so any difference smaller than 1.0 C is inside its own resolution and is not evidence.
Station humidity is derived from dewpoint, not measured directly.
Distance and elevation account for part of any difference. See comparator.
